title: timeoff.decided.v1
description: Published when a time off request is approved or refused. `requester` is the account that submitted it. No dates, leave type or person id. Delivered at least once; consumers de-duplicate on `id`. Carries identifiers, dates and counts only: no names, amounts, reasons or other text (fetch the record through the capability if the token allows).

id.description: Unique event id, stable across redeliveries.
